title: Failure cleanup removes state the operation did not create

scenario.observed_change: A multi-step mutation records only destination names, then on a later failure deletes those destinations without proving that the current entries are still the ones created by this operation.
controlled_inputs: concurrent replacement of a created entry
mutable_state: identity and ownership of destination entries
authority_boundaries: operation-owned state versus pre-existing or concurrently replaced state
operation_model: another actor replaces or rebinds that entry
rollback deletes the current entry by name

required_invariants.requirement: Rollback must remove only state that can still be established as owned by the failed operation.

must_identify: name-only cleanup can delete state that no longer belongs to the operation
must_not_claim: safe rollback merely because the operation originally created an entry with the same name
